title: Animate this into a stop motion style motion sequence video image as each layer…
content: Animate this into a stop motion style motion sequence video image as each layer sliding into the frame from different angles and places. Generating your stop-motion paper-craft assembly video now. The animation will show each torn paper layer sliding, dropping, and rotating into frame from different angles, pitch strips from below, stadium from the sides, the player assembling piece by piece from above, all with paper. ASMR foley sounds. Every piece enters as a flat pre-made cutout pushed in from outside the frame edges (bottom, sides, top, corners). no folding, no constructing in place. ASMR foley sounds. No other sound except paper sound. Style is vox editorial style, paper cut, torn paper, stop motion

La animación mostrará cada capa de papel rasgado deslizándose, cayendo y girando en el cuadro desde diferentes ángulos, tiras inclinadas desde abajo, estadio desde los lados, el jugador ensamblándose pieza por pieza desde arriba, todo con papel. Sonidos ASMR de foley. Ningún otro sonido excepto el sonido del papel. El estilo es estilo editorial vox, corte de papel, papel rasgado, stop motion.
